query: SELECT cm.slug as moduleSlug, cl.orderIndex, cl.title, LENGTH(cl.content) as contentLength, cl.linkedScenarioId FROM course_lessons cl JOIN course_modules cm ON cl.moduleId = cm.id WHERE cm.slug IN ('industrial-networking', 'robotics-fundamentals', 'power-distribution', 'sensors-instrumentation') ORDER BY cm.slug, cl.orderIndex LIMIT 20;
